howToSave.intro: Payhip blocks automated access to its store pages, so the importer needs copies of them saved from your own browser:
steps: Open your Payhip store and press Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on a Mac).
Set "Save as type" to "Webpage, HTML only".
Give the file a name with the page number, e.g. "store-1.html" — every page of the store has the same title, so the browser suggests the same file name each time.
If there are page numbers under the products (1, 2, 3… Next), open each page and save it the same way: store-2.html, store-3.html, …
Pick all the saved files below at once. Their order doesn't matter.
